comments: 920718f5: ;Call the DE (Data Entry) routine to initialize variables.
1a620dac: ;Set the file and global root. Also kill variables DG, DE, and DB.
8648a981: ;If a transaction date exists, store it in the DE array.
c91bbde7: ;Kill %Z and quit.
ca6ee316: ;Write the field label to the screen.
ed83fd2f: ;Quit the current iteration.
39982e97: ;Write the field data value and control what line it prints on.
d73624d9: ;If the field value is longer than 19 characters and the DIRUT is not DIROUT or DIQUIT, go to RW^DIR2.
022b28f8: ;If DIRUT is DIQUIT, and this is a non-editable field, write '(No Editing)'.
7ee92db5: ;Read in the user's response, timing out after DTIME, and store in X. If timed out, set DTOUT=U.
1317abce: Quit if X is null.
3b60844a: Increment the data queue counter for each iteration.
01038e28: Branch to the next instruction based on the value in DQ.
004f2dd4: If the extended reference DE(DQ) is defined, go to PR; otherwise, execute W and TR.
1db213f7: If X is null, go to A unless DV contains 'R'. If X is false, go to A unless DV is true. If D is negative or zero, go to X; otherwise, go to A.
c0f84865: If X starts with '?', go to QS. If X contains '^', execute D and go to ^DIE17.
5be015a2: If X is '@', execute D and go to Z^DIE2.
9ece8fcd: If X is a space, DV contains 'd' but not 'P', and ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB) is defined, set X to the value at ^(DLB). If DV does not contain 'D' or 'S', write '  '_X.

1321dd58: If DV is true, go to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', go to ^DIE3. If DV does not contain 'S', go to P. If ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1) is defined, execute X:$D(^(12.1)). Set % to the piece after ';'_X_':' in ';'_DU. Set Y to X. If % is non-null, execute DIC("S") if defined. If no DB(DQ) is defined, write '  '_%. Go to V.
16b28686: Checks if the string Y from DU contains the search string X. If it does, and DIC("S") is defined, it executes the code in DIC("S"). If DG (the position of X in Y) is 0, it does not quit.
27be9a37: Writes the substring of YS starting from the position DG until the end, but only if DB(DQ) is undefined. It then sets X to the portion of YS before the colon.

5facd074: If DV contains "P", it sets DIC to U_DU, and DIC(0) to either "ENM" or "EM" based on whether DB(DQ) is defined. If DV doesn't contain "'", it appends "L" to DIC(0). If DIC(0) contains "L", it sets DLAYGO to the 2nd piece of DV after "P". If DV doesn't contain "*", it calls ^DIC, sets X to the value of Y, and sets DIC to DIE. If X is negative, it goes to the X label.

11347ce2: If DV doesn't contain "N", it goes to the V label. Otherwise, it calls the D routine. If the length of the portion of X after the decimal point is greater than 24, it kills (undefines) X and goes to the Z label.

7a84e221: The condition checks if the value of X has a decimal point and is not of exponential notation, and if the 5th piece of DQ(DQ) doesn't start with a dollar sign. If these conditions are met, it performs formatting operations on X to remove leading and trailing zeros, and to remove the decimal point if there are no digits after it. The resulting formatted value is stored back in X.
88ca694f: Kill off YS to reset the variable.

1cf0b2a0: Skip the current question if DIC("S") is defined, and if the current field has a d-type cross reference, save any previous response and branch to label A if the user entered something other than ^ to exit.
8c33ca27: If the user enters ?? (double question marks), display the WORD-PROCESSING HELP if it exists for the current field, otherwise branch to standard help processing.
fc21e4a6: If we reach this point, the user's response was invalid, so set X to ?BAD to trigger an error.
bf3c0f91: Save the user's response in DZ, call D to set up DQ array for the current field, call QQ^DIEQ to perform Q-type input transformation, and go to label B.
025a8d69: Set up DQ array elements: field global node @("D") in D, field/file # in DQ(DQ), label_^global_root^global_data_^ien_^code in DQ(DQ).

91ed62e3: If DE(DQ) (field input instructions) doesn't exist, call O (not shown) to display standard prompts. If X is not "@", go to RD (Read). If this isn't a LAYGO field and X is "@", go to A to add a new entry. Else if X is "@", set X=Y from DE(DQ) and go to N (not shown).
9938736b: Process parameter in DATA TYPE field.
0be7d4ca: If parameter is pointer, follow the pointer logic.
a760755a: If parameter is variable pointer, follow the variable pointer logic.
b1ea617c: If there is a default value for the field, assign it to Y.

fc90550d: If the field is required and the input is blank, retrieve the default value. If the field is not required and the input is blank, quit. If the user has requested to bypass the input value (DC=2), quit. Otherwise, go to the word-processing routine to handle input transformation.
cae26058: If the field is not an input transform or computed field, perform data validation.

f342f08c: Execute any executable help nodes associated with the field. If X is defined after that (i.e., the user entered data), go to the data validation routine. Otherwise, go to the prompt routine.
809cb257: Quit if there are no more fields to process.
40aac76f: Set initial variables for field processing.
6f5773b5: Set field-specific variables: DW=input transform, DV=data validation, DU=auditing data, DLB=field label, DIFLD=field number.
e7b03b8e: ;Set DU to the global root for the USER File (#200).
bc78cd74: ;Exit the current routine and jump to the RE label.
0f22b2c8: ;Quit from the routine at the X1 label.

5b36b7cc: ;If the DG array is defined and has more than 9 nodes, execute the F^DIE17 routine to perform field-level actions, set Y to the delimiter character U, DQ to 2, execute the X2 routine, then either quit if Y is undefined or if Y equals U, otherwise set X to Y, set DIC(0) to "F" to indicate a file lookup, set DW to DQ, and jump to the OUT^DIE17 routine.
97472c2c: If X is empty, set the 5th piece of the 'DT' node to an empty string, set DGJTST to 'TRANSCRIBED', and set Y to '@2'
cad9afc9: Quit the current execution

c5589054: If DG is defined, execute the F^DIE17 routine, set Y to the user's device control character, set DQ to 3, execute the X3 routine. If Y is undefined or equal to the user's device control character, go to the A label. Otherwise, set X to Y, set DIC(0) to 'F', set DW to DQ, and go to the OUT^DIE17 routine.
75ce78c6: Set DGJTST variable to 'SIGNED' to indicate a document has been signed.
f505d1af: Quit the current procedure.
f6adedcf: If DG array is defined and certain conditions are met, execute certain procedures and set output codes accordingly.
3bf2b5c9: If the third piece of DGJTDEL is not 1, set DGJTST to 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' and Y to '@2' (a specific code).
e56507fd: Quit the current procedure.
1021d678: If DG array is defined and certain conditions are met, execute a procedure, then go to label ^DGJXA15.
